exclude.description:
Fields to be excluded from being matched
Separate each of the field names with ,
 ```
   e.g. CollectionUpdateSpec.make().withExclude("foo, faa");
 ```

include.description:
Fields to be compared
Separate each of the field names with ,
 ```
   e.g. CollectionUpdateSpec.make().withInclude("foo, faa");
 ```
if this is not set it will compare all the fields of the objects

uniqueFieldPath.description:
Path on the obj (Should lead to a primitive value) to use to evaluate uniqueness. Defaults to `id` field for
instances of {@link WithUniqueId} and `name` for {@link WithUniqueName}

title: Spec for checking difference between two collections
name: CollectionUpdateSpec
